correctness.rationale: For t>0 the 16-state generator is irreducible and its normalized stationary solution analytic near delta=0. At zero bias product measure has defect-site occupation 1/(1+t). The Taylor coefficients p0,p1,p2 obey exact generator response recurrences. Independently rebuilt the generator and checked ALL exact polynomial identities in the package certificate.json using BigInt integer-polynomial operations: zero-order stationarity, two response balances, three normalizations, both C1/C2 current identities, and coefficient positivity; all checks true. This validates C1=2tR/D and C2=2t(t-1)P/((1+t)D^2), where P,D,R have strictly positive coefficients. Independent exact-rational 16-state stationary derivative solves at t=1/2,1,2,3 reproduce the formula and C2 signs. Reflection rules out even-in-bias terms for chains of length <=3 with clean boundaries and one interior defect; t!=1 provides four-site witness. Local δ expansion only, not a global-in-δ sign.

A rigorous exact coefficient valid for any positive defect rate and a sign reversal at t=1 provide a model-calibration benchmark stronger than approximate closure, while sharp minimality identifies precisely when transport rectification can begin.
